title: Spellmight Gloves
summary: Trade spell attack accuracy for extra damage.

fields.Spellmight: Toggle on to take −5 to spell attack rolls and deal an extra 1d8 damage on qualifying spell hits. Works with multiple rays. The source reports smite spells except Divine Smite can gain the extra damage without the attack penalty.
fields.Acquisition: Lucretious rewards Find Dribbles the Clown, or can be pickpocketed or looted.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
